$comment: Source of truth for SECURITY dependency overrides (transitive version pins added to remediate a vulnerability). Intentional, permanent pins (e.g. react, drizzle-orm) are NOT tracked here - only stop-gaps that should be removed once the dependency graph naturally resolves to a safe version. The daily security-maintenance workflow re-validates each entry by removing it, re-resolving, and checking whether the graph still lands at/above `safeFloor`; redundant entries are auto-PR'd for removal. `audit:overrides:check` (PR CI) keeps this file and package.json `overrides`/`resolutions` in sync. See scripts/audit-overrides.ts.

overrides.name: ws
overrides.reason: A transitive consumer pulled ws 8.20.1 into the production image; 8.21.0 is the first fixed release.
overrides.removeWhen: No dependency resolves ws below 8.21.0 without this override.

overrides.name: minimatch
overrides.reason: monaco-languageclient -> vscode-languageclient@9.0.1 pins minimatch ^5.1.0, pulling the vulnerable 5.1.9 into the bundled Monaco editor. 10.x is the fixed line; the matching API used (minimatch(path, pattern)) is unchanged.
overrides.removeWhen: vscode-languageclient (via monaco-languageclient) widens its minimatch range to a fixed release, or no dependency resolves minimatch below 10.2.5.

overrides.name: postcss-selector-parser
overrides.reason: Transitive build-tooling dependency (postcss) pulled 6.1.2; 7.1.4 is the fixed release. Build-time only (not in the production runtime image).
overrides.removeWhen: No dependency resolves postcss-selector-parser below 7.1.4 without this override.
